jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
Company Description

Everyone’s story matters. Come shape your story with us at Riverty.

But where does that take you?

To one of our 30 hybrid workspaces – designed for exchanging ideas, learning from others, and shaping the way we work. An international community of over 4,000 people, representing almost 80 nationalities across 11 countries. United by one mission: Combining empathy, advanced technology and data-driven insights to keep people and businesses in flow. With payments made for them. So that they don’t have to worry about it.

And there’s more.
We are part of the family-owned Bertelsmann group. Established. Corporate. In a fast-paced industry. We enable flexible payments in various industries, simplifying the financial management of known brands and helping people repay debt to build financial confidence. In short: shaping FinTech.

Job Description

We are looking for a

Senior Backend Engineer (C#/.Net) (m/f/d)

Join our team at our location in Stockholm or Tallinn – hybrid working conditions available.

Our solutions contribute to flexible and customer-friendly payment alternatives. We offer consumers the opportunity to choose when and how they want to pay, whilst guaranteeing a steady and predictable cashflow for merchants. Our products make us proud, but not content and we have high ambitions for our existing as well as upcoming products. We have a strong commitment to building the future of FinTech — human-centric and sustainable. With investments to back it up. You will be part of a new and quickly growing product & tech organisation, having the opportunity to shape our new teams as well as build the next revolutionary products.

You will join one of our product teams and on a daily basis:

Design, develop, test, and ship robust, maintainable, and readable software, applications, APIs, and other workflows
Initiate, participate in, and communicate technical architecture designs
Attend regular scrum ceremonies as a member of an agile cross-functional team
Analyze, discuss, and implement business requirements while maintaining good documentation of the systems and components you create
Bring in industry standards and best practices to continually improve our codebase and architecture
Make a positive impact on our engineering culture by adopting, implementing, and providing feedback on both organisational and industry standards and practices

Qualifications

What you bring:

Hands-on experience with C# and the .NET framework, with a minimum of 5 years of experience
Experience in developing, shipping, and maintaining cloud-based applications
Good knowledge and experience working with microservices and distributed architectures
A deep understanding and knowledge of RESTful APIs
Years of experience using relational databases, preferably SQL Server. Additionally, working knowledge of ORMs, preferably Entity Framework
Familiarity with cloud development; experience with Azure is a bonus
Practical knowledge of using messaging platforms in a distributed architecture (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka)
Knowledge and experience on a FinTech and banking industry is a plus
Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Claude, Cursor, or GitHub Copilot, and sound judgement about reviewing and testing what they produce, is a plus
Fluent English

Please note:
you need to have EU citizenship or a valid work permit for Germany.

About The Technologies We Use

Our teams have autonomy when it comes to tech choices. The example below will give you some insights, and we are looking forward to discussing this further with you.

All solutions developed cloud-native targeting Azure - Infrastructure defined using Terraform - Services deployed to Kubernetes clusters by default - A growing microservice ecosystem with event-based integration - Using latest .NET Core - RESTful API design - Single-page frontend apps served by CDN - Frontend tech using TypeScript, often Angular or standard Web Components (Stencil) - Automated tests in each layer.

Additional Information

Disclosure requirements pertaining to the collection of your personal data:

Responsible for processing the information provided in your application is the company specified in the job advertisement, with its registered office as indicated. The company processes your data for the purpose of establishing an employment relationship on the basis of Art. 6 (1) b GDPR / Section 26 (1) sentence 1 BDSG.

The retention period for your data is determined by the statutory time limits applicable in the respective country, beginning upon completion of the recruitment process. You can find these here.

You can contact the company’s Data Protection Officer at the above-mentioned postal address.

Further information on data protection and your rights can be found here.

jobs.description:
Software Senior Engineer, Global Test Engineering Cork

Location: Cork on-site

The Global Test Engineering (GTE)
team develops advanced manufacturing test automation solutions for Dell's portfolio of AI Server and Storage
products.
Over the next 2-3 years
, we are modernizing AI rack-level testing into an AI-driven, scalable, and secure platform
, accelerating time-to-market for industry-leading AI infrastructure used by the world's most innovative companies.

This is an excellent opportunity for a Software Senior Engineer
to contribute to high-impact systems, gain deep product exposure, and grow technical leadership skills within a fast-evolving engineering organization.

What You'll Achieve

As a Software Senior Engineer
, you will design, develop, and deliver high-quality software solutions aligned with Dell's manufacturing, product, and business requirements.

You will:
Contribute across the Software Development Lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, and deployment
Develop scalable, reliable, and maintainable software for manufacturing test and automation environments
Collaborate closely with product, manufacturing, and test engineering teams to understand system behaviour and requirements
Work within an Agile development team, contributing to sprint planning, reviews, and continuous improvement
Debug and resolve complex technical issues across software and system boundaries
Apply emerging technologies, including AI-assisted and agentic workflows, to improve test efficiency and development velocity
Share knowledge and best practices, providing technical guidance to less experienced engineers and influence strategies at an organisational level

Essential Requirements

5-7 years of relevant software engineering experience
Solid experience in software development and engineering fundamentals
Strong Proficiency in one or more programming languages, with the ability to design, code, test, and debug complex systems (C#, Python, Java, SQL)
Experience working with operating systems, networking concepts, and system-level interactions and exposure to multiple tools, databases, operating systems, and hardware platforms
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with the ability to learn and adapt to new technologies, tools, and environments
Effective communication and collaboration skills within cross-functional teams

Desirable Requirements

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, SW Engineering or equivalent
Experience with manufacturing systems, test automation, embedded software, firmware, BIOS, or device-level integration
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, automation frameworks, and AI-assisted development tools

We believe that each of us has the power to make an impact. That's why we put our team members at the center of everything we do. If you're looking for an opportunity to grow your career with some of the best minds and most advanced tech in the industry, we're looking for you.

Dell Technologies is a unique family of businesses that helps individuals and organizations transform how they work, live and play. Join us to build a future that works for everyone because Progress Takes All of Us.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Analyst / Systems Specialist (Cloud Platform Integration)
jobs.location: Bishan, Central Singapore Community Development Council, Singapore
jobs.description:
Job description:

Job Purpose

The candidate will implement and design technical interfaces across heterogeneous environments securely using centralized middleware and reporting including translating business requirements into technical blueprint and specification, which includes configuration, assessing and communicating impact and using business rules to automate decisions related to a process or integration scenarios. He/she will provide solutions to the business requirement including effort estimation (configuration, workflow, interface, report, data mapping), change impact analysis and ensuring technical integrity of the delivered solution.
Responsibilities

Senior Systems Analyst duties and responsibilities include:

Translate user requirements into technical specifications (of middleware) and perform feasibility study and propose sound integration solution, create program specification. Perform system development work based on the specification. Conduct quality check, ABAP Code Review if applicable, quality testing and fulfil the tasks based on the specification before requesting for user acceptance test. Preparation of UAT test cases, cutover activities.
Follow the agreed timeline set by the team leader and ensure there is no delay in completing.
Involve in Project implementation. In addition, he/she will be required to follow the SDLC documentation policy and involved and responsible for all types of system documentation.
Monitor, facilitate and report the timely and successful resolution of all critical interface issues and risks. Make sure SOPs are practiced
Develop, update and ensure the accuracy of the Interface Coordination Plan during all implementation projects
Report the status of interface integration issues and their status via various communication methods on a pre-defined frequency to the application team
Work with vendor or project manager on new integration with SAP, Non SAP Systems like Maximo, .net Systems etc. as well as troubleshoot complex/interface issues and document solutions
Give application technical support for month end / year end closing cycles and internal/external audit wherever applicable.
Manage system incident tickets/service request to ensure SLA compliance and customer satisfaction.
Carry out root-cause analysis, contribute to knowledge base, and provide recommendations for continuous improvements to workflow, process, and technology.
Any other tasks assigned by the managers.

Qualifications & Work Experience

Possess a Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology with at least 3–5 years of experience in ERP implementation and support lifecycle using middleware, with strong understanding of business integration needs.
Design and develop SAP PI/PO/CPI integrations, including ESR (Enterprise Services Repository) and Integration Directory configurations.
Implement and support end-to-end integration solutions across SAP and non-SAP systems, ensuring reliable and scalable connectivity.
Configure and manage SAP PI/PO/CPI interfaces, including routing rules, adapters, and backend system connections.
Develop and enhance integration mappings using graphical mappings, XSLT, Java mappings, and UDFs, with solid understanding of PI/PO/CPI architecture.
Administer and maintain SLD configuration and support SAP ECC HANA and cloud-based environments (Integration Suite/CPI), including migration from PI to CPI.
Prepare and execute technical specifications, UAT test cases, and cutover activities, while demonstrating strong analytical skills, independent work capability, and effective stakeholder and escalation management.

Skills

Technical skills include:

Demonstrate proficiency in SAP PI 7.5 and SAP Integration Suite (CPI) for enterprise integration solutions.
Develop and manage interfaces between SAP and third-party systems (e.g., Maximo, Anaplan, Treasury systems).
Configure and maintain integration components including SLD, ESR (Integration Repository), Integration Directory (ID), and central monitoring tools.
Design and implement message structures and technical configurations, ensuring effective message processing and XML-based transformations.
Utilize and manage connectivity frameworks (Proxy & Adapter Framework) and adapters such as File/FTP, HTTP, IDoc, JDBC, SOAP, RFC, and REST APIs.
Apply integration technologies including SOAP, REST, OData, Groovy scripting, XML, XSLT, and JSON transformations within CPI.
Prepare and support testing and documentation deliverables (unit/integration testing, user manuals, KT materials), while collaborating with ABAP teams and ensuring clear status reporting.
